decisions.rationale: Reviewed Mkhedruli mapping is deterministic, reversible within the profile, independently grounded in Georgian State Language Department transcription guidance and the current ISO Georgian transliteration standard, with YA=/ja/ represented explicitly as ია.

Reviewed Eastern Armenian mapping is deterministic and profile-scoped, with Eastern phonetic targeting explicitly documented and independent ISO/Library of Congress evidence. Western Armenian remains outside the profile.

The profile is intentionally fully vocalized; explicit fatḥa/kasra/ḍamma keeps the canonical A/I/U distinctions visible and deterministic. The marked fully-vocalized style is part of the profile contract rather than ordinary prose guidance.

Hindi-oriented Devanagari follows the Government of India principle of maximum practical approximation to source pronunciation, documents vowel realization differences, and preserves /z/ using nukta ज़.

Government of Bangladesh dictionary evidence resolves the former YA/ZU blockers: foreign y- is represented with ইয়া/ইয়া and foreign z with জ. The /z/→জ realization is explicitly treated as a Bengali approximation.

Persian I/U are represented with ی/و, matching documented Persian vowel-letter practice and avoiding the earlier erroneous assumption that short kasra/damma encode Persian /i,u/. Length differences remain explicit approximations.
